note: The six capability clusters of the whole-venture monorepo thesis (Grokbot, 2026-11-08), as Naive data (lead agents design, build plan item 7). One outside tool per cluster, not one per function. A cluster names no vendor: vendor research in the thesis is blocked, and a venture's connection record (it/connections/<id>.json) names its own system. Checked by packages/naive/src/checks/check-connections.ts.

gap_kinds.means: Law or regulation gives the authority to someone outside the repository: a signature that binds, privileged storage, tax filing, data-subject rights, securities rules
Reaching a network or moving money needs a rail the repository cannot be: bank and payment rails, email delivery with consent and unsubscribe
Something has to run and hold state outside Git: hosting, databases, an identity provider, secrets, access-controlled private data
People would rather work in a tool's interface than in files; the weakest reason, and alone it rarely justifies a connection

clusters.title: Identity and secrets
clusters.why: GitHub gives the org, teams and CODEOWNERS; an identity provider and a secrets store have to run outside Git so that accounts, access and credentials work at runtime

clusters.title: Messaging delivery
clusters.why: Templates live in Git; delivery, consent and unsubscribe need a delivery network

clusters.title: Money and books
clusters.why: Models and budgets live in Git; bank and payment rails, payroll remittance, tax filing and securities rules for crowdfunding sit outside it

clusters.title: Runtime and data
clusters.why: Code and config live in Git; hosting, databases and telemetry run outside it, and private profile data must not sit in every clone

clusters.title: Signatures and privileged records
clusters.why: Templates and the request log live in Git; a binding e-signature, privileged storage and data-subject requests need an authority outside it

clusters.title: Private contact records
clusters.why: A few deals or contacts can live in issues or YAML; contact privacy, private inbound threads, candidate data and data-room access control need an access-controlled store, and volume work wants a tool's interface
